title: With...End With accesses members off an implicit receiver — C# has no equivalent and needs a local
sourceContent:
Public Class InvoiceBuilder
    Public Sub Populate(inv As Invoice)
        With inv
            .Number = NextNumber()
            .Total = .Subtotal + .Tax   ' .Subtotal / .Tax read off the SAME receiver
            .Status = "DRAFT"
        End With
    End Sub
End Class
notes: With...End With binds a receiver so members can be accessed with a leading dot. C# has no With statement, so the target must introduce a local (`var inv = ...`) and qualify each member, being careful that a `With` over an expression with side effects is evaluated exactly once. Straightforward but every member access must be rewritten.
